Japan’s Largest Brokerage Nomura Explores Sale of Crypto Unit Laser Digital

According to Bloomberg, Japan’s Nomura Holdings is exploring a potential sale of its crypto unit Laser Digital and has held talks with prospective buyers, including Marex Group, which is evaluating a deal. No final decision has been made, and Nomura may retain the business. Losses at Laser Digital amid crypto market volatility pushed Nomura’s European operations into a quarterly loss, prompting tighter risk controls.
